main.description: Migrate an account's store and make sure it holds a KEM key, returning the key for the caller to publish in the account's DID document. PDS-internal and temporary: it exists for the migration into spaces.

kemKey.description: The public key of the account's KEM keypair, as a did:key.

signingKey.description: The account's repo signing key, as a did:key. The DID document must name it for the caller to publish.
